Details 
 Experience elevated craftsmanship in the women’s Rose Blush/Cloud Durango® Arena Elite™ collection. This style features roughout full-grain leather foot and pull straps with full-grain leather shaft, cow leather lining, Durango® Sole Comfort Footbed™ and a cushion flex insole with rigid rear foot stabilizer. The shank is nylon and has a rolled shank area, while the outsole is hand nailed genuine leather.
 This style is finished off with a ¾ genuine Goodyear® welt construction, genuine leather welt with single row cotton stitch, high-abrasion resistant rubber heel lift, leather stacked heel base, 1 ½” long base riding heel and a cutter toe. Get a pair today!
